blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The low pressure area (LPA) outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) has a “high chance” of developing into a tropical depression within the next 24 hours, the state weather bureau said on Tuesday. READ: Trough of LPA outside PAR to affect parts of Visayas, Mindanao Tuesday This is based as of 8 a.m. on the 24-hour tropical cyclone formation outlook issued by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) issued at 10 a.m. The LPA was last estimated 1,760 kilometers east of Eastern Visayas, moving north-northwest at 15 kilometers per hour.
